                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Section 27.5: Maxwell Electromagnetism, Poincaré/Twistor Gimbal-Lock Elimination, Longitudinal $E_z$, OAM Tubular Solitons, and TRUE-Conjugated Soft Photons via QFIM and the Fubini–Study Kähler Metric (maxwell_em_poincare_ez_oam_true_qfim_and_fubini_study_identities) #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Connects the Quantum Fisher Information Metric (QFIM) $= 4\times$ Fubini–Study Kähler metric ($F_{\mu\nu} = 4\,g_{\mu\nu}^{\mathrm{FS}}$) directly to the Maxwell electromagnetic formulations, longitudinal $E_z$ & OAM tubular solitons, and TRUE-conjugated soft-photon transceivers of Section 26:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    1. Poincaré Sphere $\mathbb{CP}^1 = \mathrm{Gr}_{\mathbb{C}}(1,2)$ Non-Degenerate QFIM vs. Euler Gimbal Lock: While 3-angle Euler beam/polarization charts degenerate at $\theta = \pi/2$ (eulerKinematicJacobianDet (Real.pi / 2) = 0), the projective spinor/twistor Fubini–Study metric $g_{\theta\theta}^{\mathrm{FS}} = 1/4$ (poincareSphereFubiniStudyTheta) and QFIM $F_{\theta\theta} = 4\,g_{\theta\theta}^{\mathrm{FS}} = 1$ (poincareSphereQfimTheta) remain strictly positive and nonsingular everywhere on $\mathbb{CP}^1$.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    2. 3D Vectorial $(E_x, E_y, E_z)$ Fisher Information Dominance Over Paraxial 2D Jones Optics: Including the Gauss-law longitudinal channel $p_z > 0$ (vectorialEzThreeChannelFisher) strictly increases Fisher information ($I_{\mu\mu}^{\mathrm{2D}} < I_{\mu\mu}^{\mathrm{3D}}$) whenever $\partial_\mu p_z \neq 0$, quantifying the metrological information discarded by paraxial models.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    3. OAM Helical Wavefronts & Tubular Solitons ($F_{\varphi\varphi}^{\mathrm{OAM}}(\ell) = 4\ell^2$): On balanced OAM superpositions $(|\ell\rangle + |-\ell\rangle)/\sqrt{2}$, the azimuthal QFIM is $F_{\varphi\varphi}^{\mathrm{OAM}}(\ell) = 4\,g_{\varphi\varphi}^{\mathrm{FS}}(\ell) = 4\ell^2$, compressing the angular Quantum Cramér–Rao bound to $\frac{1}{4 N_{\mathrm{probes}} \ell^2}$ ($|\ell| = 3$ achieves $9\times$ lower angular variance than $|\ell| = 1$) while the projective QFIM energy vanishes smoothly at the hollow vortex core $\rho = 0$ (projectiveQfimEnergyFromRayMetric).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    4. Multi-Mode TRUE Phase-Conjugated Soft-Photon QFIM Enhancement & Orbital QFIM Light Bending: Coherent TRUE time-reversal over $N_{\mathrm{modes}}$ spatial modes scales effective soft-photon QFIM by $N_{\mathrm{modes}}\times$ (trueConjugatedSoftPhotonQfimGain), while substituting $\mathcal{D}(W_{\mathrm{orb}}) = 3 + (F_{ee}^{\mathrm{orb}}(e))^{-1}$ into turnerPluckerKahlerLightDeflection recovers exact 1PN Einstein solar light deflection ($\varepsilon_{\mathrm{rel}} = 0$).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Section 27.6: Complex Plabic Vector-Relation Configurations (VRC) and the Quantum Fisher Information Metric (QFIM) $= 4\times$ Fubini–Study Kähler Metric: Pole-Free On-Shell Resonance ($x_X = -1$), Complex Denominator-Clearing Gauge Invariance, and MRA-PNO / Tequila Quantum Natural Gradient (vrc_fubini_study_kahler_qfim_pole_free_resonance_and_critique_fixes_identities) #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Unites our Complex Plabic Vector-Relation Configurations (VRC, (V, K) with $V K^\top = 0$) from Companion Papers 18, 22, 23, 24, 39, 43, and 44 (Signals.Plabic.gr24HomogeneousVRC, Signals.Plabic.gr24MutatedHomogeneousVRC, Signals.DFT.vrcRegularizedPnoAmplitude) with the Quantum Fisher Information Metric (QFIM) $F_{\mu\nu} = 4\,g_{\mu\nu}^{\mathrm{FS}}$ and Fubini–Study Kähler metric, and proves four adversarial critique fixes:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                1. Critique & Fix VRC-1 — Pole-Free VRC Fubini–Study Metric & QFIM Across the $x_X = -1$ On-Shell Polariton / Antibonding / Conical-Intersection Resonance (vrcResonantPluckerNormSq, vrcResonantDirectionalJetX1, vrcResonantFubiniStudyX1, vrcResonantQfimX1):
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Critique: In the rational Plabic face-weight chart $C_{\mathrm{rat}}(x_1, x_2, x_X)$, the square-move cluster mutation $x_1' = (x_1 x_X + x_2)/(x_X + 1)$ divides by zero at the on-shell resonance $x_X = -1$ ($x_X + 1 = 0$), causing the coordinate Jacobian $\partial x_1'/\partial x_X$ to blow up as $(x_X + 1)^{-2}$ and rational-chart Fubini–Study / QFIM evaluations to diverge as $(x_X + 1)^{-4}$.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Machine-Checked Fix: In gr24MutatedHomogeneousVRC x1 x2 (-1), the 6 Plücker minors $(1, 0, x_2, x_2 - x_1, 1, x_2(x_1 - x_2))$ have strictly positive polynomial norm squared $\rho_{\mathrm{VRC}}^{(-1)}(x_1, x_2) = 2 + x_2^2 + (x_2 - x_1)^2(1 + x_2^2) \ge 2 > 0$. Along $x_1$, the $(x_2 - x_1)^2(1 + x_2^2)^2$ terms in $\rho\langle\partial_{x_1}\Psi\mid\partial_{x_1}\Psi\rangle - |\langle\Psi\mid\partial_{x_1}\Psi\rangle|^2$ cancel identically, leaving $(2 + x_2^2)(1 + x_2^2) > 0$ and closed pole-free metrics $F_{x_1 x_1}^{\mathrm{VRC}}|_{x_X=-1} = 4\,g_{x_1 x_1}^{\mathrm{FS,VRC}}|_{x_X=-1} = \frac{4(2 + x_2^2)(1 + x_2^2)}{(\rho_{\mathrm{VRC}}^{(-1)}(x_1, x_2))^2} > 0$.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2. Critique & Fix VRC-2 — Exact Invariance of $g_{\mu\mu}^{\mathrm{FS}}$ and $F_{\mu\mu} = 4\,g_{\mu\mu}^{\mathrm{FS}}$ Under Coordinate-Dependent Complex VRC Denominator Clearing (complexRescaledVrcJet):
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Critique: Clearing rational chart poles $x_X^{-1}$ and $(x_X + 1)^{-1}$ multiplies the homogeneous Plücker vector by a coordinate-dependent factor $\tilde{\Psi}(x) = s(x)\,e^{i\chi(x)}\,\Psi(x)$ with radial logarithmic derivative $\sigma_\mu = (\partial_\mu s)/s$ and phase gradient $d\chi = \partial_\mu\chi$, which shifts $\tilde{\rho} = s^2\rho$, $\partial_\mu\tilde{\rho} = s^2(\partial_\mu\rho + 2\sigma_\mu\rho)$, and $\tilde{\mathcal{A}}_\mu = \mathcal{A}_\mu + d\chi$. Does this denominator-clearing factor distort the Fubini–Study Kähler metric or QFIM?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Machine-Checked Fix: In the 3-channel Madelung–QFIM split, Channel 1 absorbs $d\chi$ and Channel 2 absorbs $\sigma_\mu$, while Channel 3's projective metrics $g_{\mu\mu}^{\mathrm{FS}}$ and $F_{\mu\mu} = 4\,g_{\mu\mu}^{\mathrm{FS}}$ are identically invariant under arbitrary $s \neq 0$, $\sigma_\mu \in \mathbb{R}$, and $d\chi \in \mathbb{R}$.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                3. Critique & Fix VRC-3 — VRC-Regularized MRA-PNO Pair Excitation Gap QFIM at HOMO–LUMO Degeneracy $\Delta\varepsilon = 0$ and Tequila Quantum Natural Gradient Step (vrcPnoGapFubiniStudyAtDegeneracy, vrcPnoGapQfimAtDegeneracy, vrcQuantumNaturalGradientStep):
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Critique: Standard MP2/PNO pair amplitudes $T_{ij}^{ab} = -g_{ij}^{ab}/\Delta\varepsilon$ diverge at HOMO–LUMO degeneracy $\Delta\varepsilon \to 0$, and Euclidean vs. Fubini–Study vs. QFIM natural gradients have conflicting step-size conventions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Machine-Checked Fix: Using vrcRegularizedPnoAmplitude $T_{\mathrm{VRC}}(\Delta\varepsilon) = \frac{-g\,\Delta\varepsilon}{\Delta\varepsilon^2 + \gamma_{\mathrm{VRC}}^2}$ on $\mathbb{CP}^1 = \mathrm{Gr}_{\mathbb{C}}(1,2)$ yields finite gap QFIM $F_{\Delta\varepsilon,\Delta\varepsilon}^{\mathrm{PNO}}|_{\Delta\varepsilon=0} = 4\,g_{\Delta\varepsilon,\Delta\varepsilon}^{\mathrm{FS,PNO}}|_{\Delta\varepsilon=0} = \frac{4 g^2}{\gamma_{\mathrm{VRC}}^4}$ at $\Delta\varepsilon = 0$, while the QFIM-preconditioned Quantum Natural Gradient step is exactly $\frac{1}{4}$ of the Fubini–Study-preconditioned step.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                4. Critique & Fix VRC-4 — Non-Vanishing Anchor Minors Guarantee Maximal QFIM Sensitivity at the Symmetric Constraint Locus $x_1 = x_2, x_X = -1$:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Critique: At $x_X = -1$ and $x_1 = x_2$ (where QCI-NCM intra-level destructive constraint coupling sets $P_{12} = x_2 - x_1 = 0$ and $P_{23} = x_2(x_1 - x_2) = 0$), does the VRC Fubini–Study / QFIM metric vanish or become singular?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Machine-Checked Fix: Because the anchor minors $P_{01} = 1, P_{03} = x_2, P_{13} = 1$ remain non-vanishing ($\rho_{\mathrm{VRC}}^{(-1)}(x_2, x_2) = 2 + x_2^2 \ge 2$), the metrics reduce cleanly to $g_{x_1 x_1}^{\mathrm{FS,VRC}}(x_2, x_2) = \frac{1 + x_2^2}{2 + x_2^2}$ and $F_{x_1 x_1}^{\mathrm{VRC}}(x_2, x_2) = \frac{4(1 + x_2^2)}{2 + x_2^2}$ ($= 1/2$ and $2$ at $x_1 = x_2 = 0$).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Pole-Free Resonant VRC Quantum Fisher Information Metric Along $x_1$ at $x_X = -1$ (vrcResonantQfimX1): $$F_{x_1 x_1}^{\mathrm{VRC}}\big|_{x_X=-1}(x_1, x_2) = 4\,g_{x_1 x_1}^{\mathrm{FS,VRC}}\big|_{x_X=-1}(x_1, x_2) = \frac{4\,(2 + x_2^2)(1 + x_2^2)}{\bigl(\rho_{\mathrm{VRC}}^{(-1)}(x_1, x_2)\bigr)^2}.$$
